MasulloGRH.Round16A.archimedean_full_divisor.{u_1, u_2} {ι : Type u_1} {κ : Type u_2} (R : Finset ι) (C : Finset κ)
  (r : ι → ℂ) (c : κ → ℂ) (x : ℂ) :
  meromorphicOrderAt (fun z => (∏ i ∈ R, (z + r i).Gammaℝ) * ∏ j ∈ C, (z + c j).Gammaℂ) x =
    (∑ i ∈ R, if ∃ n, (x + r i) / 2 = -↑n then -1 else 0) + ∑ j ∈ C, if ∃ n, x + c j = -↑n then -1 else 0

  (r : ι → ℂ) (c : κ → ℂ) (P : WeakFEPair ℂ) (hk : P.k = 1) (τ : ℝ) (L : ℂ → ℂ) (hL : MeromorphicOn L Set.univ)
  (hM :
    ∀ (z : ℂ),
      1 < z.re →
        HasMellin (fun t => P.f t - P.f₀) (z + ↑τ * Complex.I)
          (((∏ i ∈ R, (z + r i).Gammaℝ) * ∏ j ∈ C, (z + c j).Gammaℂ) * L z))
  (x : ℂ) :
  meromorphicOrderAt (fun z => P.Λ (z + ↑τ * Complex.I)) x =
    ((∑ i ∈ R, if ∃ n, (x + r i) / 2 = -↑n then -1 else 0) + ∑ j ∈ C, if ∃ n, x + c j = -↑n then -1 else 0) +
      meromorphicOrderAt L x
